title: Same Tree
prompt:
Return whether two binary trees are identical in both structure and values.

**Example**: `[1,2,3]` and `[1,2,3]` → `true`; `[1,2]` and `[1,null,2]` → `false`.

Walk both trees at the same time.
hints: Two trees are the same when their roots match, their left subtrees are the same, and their right subtrees are the same. In what ways can two roots fail to match?
Handle nulls first: both null → `true`; exactly one null → `false`. Then compare `p.val` with `q.val`.
Recurse on both pairs: `return isSameTree(p.left, q.left) && isSameTree(p.right, q.right);`

solution.explanation: The base cases catch every possible mismatch: the null checks catch a difference in shape, and `p.val != q.val` catches a difference in value. The recursion then requires both subtree pairs to agree. O(n) time for the smaller tree, O(h) stack. This helper is reused directly in Subtree of Another Tree.
